findings.issue: Reconciliation inventory shows API has 10 modules (auth, channels, consent, feature-flags, messages, notifications, push, reactions, webhooks, workspaces) but worker has 4 stub processors (webhook-delivery, notification, search-indexer, cleanup) that return mock responses — the worker service exists but does nothing
findings.impact: Worker deployment is cosmetic. Webhook delivery, notification processing, search indexing, cleanup are all no-ops. Any reconciliation that assumes background processing is based on a non-functional premise.
findings.fix: Either implement actual worker processor logic or remove the worker and handle background tasks in-process

findings.issue: 19 workflows exist but only 8 use Corepack-based pnpm setup — the remaining 11 workflows use stale patterns (pnpm/action-setup@v4) or are on workflow_dispatch-only with no branch triggers
findings.impact: Inconsistent CI/CD patterns across workflows. Some workflows may silently use wrong Node/pnpm versions.
findings.fix: Standardize all 19 workflows to use Corepack-based pnpm enablement pattern (enable-corepack → setup-node --corepack-enabled → pnpm install)

findings.issue: Dev compose uses Caddyfile (no env vars), prod compose uses Caddyfile.prod (domains from .env) — but devremote also uses Caddyfile with no domain override path for local development
findings.impact: Local dev on devremote compose uses production domains from Caddyfile. Developers testing on localhost will hit production DNS or get TLS errors.
findings.fix: Add Caddyfile.dev for local development with localhost domains, or add conditional domain logic in Caddyfile

findings.issue: 6 docs/architecture/*.md files reference old Traefik-based routing or Debian-based setup — current infra uses Caddy + Ubuntu. Docs lag actual infra by 1-2 iterations.
findings.impact: Anyone reading docs to understand architecture gets a misleading mental model. Reconciliation that trusts docs over code will propagate errors.
findings.fix: Update all architecture docs to reflect current Caddy + Ubuntu stack before running reconciliation

findings.issue: 24 migrations exist but 2 are duplicate pairs (add_missing_indexes ×2, enforce_data_retention ×2) — unclear which is canonical
findings.impact: New DB setups applying all 24 migrations will create duplicate indexes and policies. Schema drift between environments.
findings.fix: Remove superseded migration files. Document which migrations are canonical.

findings.issue: scripts/ contains both setup-dev.ps1 and setup-dev.sh but only setup-dev.ps1 is correct (uses supabase/migrations/*.sql). setup-dev.sh references nonexistent packages/db/sql/migrations/*.sql path.
findings.impact: macOS/Linux developers hitting setup-dev.sh will get broken migrations on first run.
findings.fix: Fix setup-dev.sh migration path to match setup-dev.ps1, or deprecate it with a shim that calls the PowerShell version

findings.issue: packages/db/src/types.ts has 7 types (WebhookEndpoint, PushSubscription, UserPreference, ConsentLog, AuditLog, ThreadParticipant, ChannelRoleOverride) that were added recently but packages/ui/ has no corresponding type exports — UI components that reference these types must import from db directly
findings.impact: Coupling between packages is undocumented. UI team must know to import types from db package. No barrel export in ui package re-exports these.
findings.fix: Add re-exports in packages/ui/src/index.ts for all shared types from packages/db

findings.issue: Only 1 service test exists (workspace.service.test.ts) across all 10 API modules. E2E test file (auth-workspace-chat.spec.ts) exists but may not run in CI without playwright browsers installed.
findings.impact: Test coverage is ~5% of the API surface. Reconciliation changes cannot be validated by automated tests.
findings.fix: Add at minimum smoke tests for each module before reconciliation. Cache playwright browsers in CI.

findings.issue: Husky pre-commit exists but runs only prettier — no eslint, no typecheck, no test run. Lint-staged config references only prettier.
findings.impact: Formatting errors caught before commit, but type errors and lint violations pass through to CI, wasting pipeline time.
findings.fix: Add eslint --fix and tsc --noEmit to the lint-staged pipeline in pre-commit hook
